name: Mean time to resolution (MTTR)
short_description: MTTR (mean time to resolution or recovery) is an operational metric for the average time it takes to restore a service after an incident; it is a key measure for incident response and DevOps performance.

evidence.quote: The first is MTTR, mean time to resolution. The second is Toil reduction.
You also need to track the reduction in mean time to resolution.
we obsess over MTTR, mean time to respond
